Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. We'd like to move forward with an onsite visit at our San Francisco office to see the Redwood inference demo and sync with our engineering, security, and procurement teams. High level ask:

- 2-hour technical demo (SE + infra deep-dive)
- 30 min procurement/contract checklist
- 30 min security Q&A (data handling, SOC2 evidence)
- Optional executive dinner the evening before for leadership alignment

Possible dates: week of March 22 or March 29. Our execs are tight on the 22nd afternoon, but have availability the evening of March 23 for dinner.

I attached a draft agenda and a site access form for attendees. Can you confirm who from Redwood would join (AE / SE / manager)? Also please advise what travel documentation you need for building access.

Thanks,
Carlos
VP, Platform Engineering
NovaCore

B) Demo day: Thu Mar 25 (09:30–12:00 PT) — exec dinner Wed Mar 24 evening
